description: This file implements file hashing and checksum verification functions for Git, including buffer verification, flushing, hash finalization, and error handling related to SHA1-summed files.

classes.name: struct hashfile
classes.description: Structure representing a hash file context used for writing files with SHA1 checksum verification.

classes.name: struct hashfile_checkpoint
classes.description: Structure holding checkpoint information for resuming hashfile operations.

methods.name: void verify_buffer_or_die(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Reads full buffer from the check_fd and compares it to the provided buffer, aborting on mismatch or error.

methods.name: void flush(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Flushes data to the underlying file, verifying data if check_fd is valid.

methods.name: void hashflush(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Finalizes current hash buffer by updating the hash context.

methods.name: void free_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a hashfile structure.

methods.name: int finalize_hashfile(struct hashfile * f,unsigned char * result,enum fsync_component component,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Finalizes all hash operations, writes out the hash, optionally flushes, fsyncs, closes file descriptors, and frees resources.

methods.name: void discard_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Closes file descriptors and frees resources without finalizing hash.

methods.name: void hashwrite(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes data to the hashfile, updating hash and buffer as needed.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_check(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile object with a check_fd pointing to a file for verification.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_internal(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp,size_t buffer_len)
methods.description: Internal function to create a hashfile object with specific parameters.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile object over a given file descriptor with default buffer size.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_throughput(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile object optimized for throughput with progress reporting.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint_init(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a checkpoint for hashfile operations.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Stores current state of hashfile in a checkpoint.

methods.name: int hashfile_truncate(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Truncates the hashfile to a checkpoint offset.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_end(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Finalizes CRC32 checksum calculation and returns the checksum value.

methods.name: int hashfile_checksum_valid(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const unsigned char * data,size_t total_len)
methods.description: Validates the checksum of given data against the hash algorithm.
